answer: Decaying identity bonds block bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks a 100-unit bond as the kernel of its standing; it loses 5 units each epoch unless verified work renews it. A pulse check confirms it is still active, and peers pass on a whisper of doubt when one operator runs look-alike accounts. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 units plus 5,000 per epoch in decay, while one honest agent pays a single bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
